edits.original: Breeders select dwarfing alleles on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.replacement: Breeders select dwarfing alleles on purpose.
edits.reason: "Rather than by accident" is the ordinary-knowledge antonym of "on purpose" and adds nothing, so the trailer is cut.

edits.original: Conservation collections still accession landraces, rather than heirlooms.
edits.replacement: Conservation collections still accession landraces. These are locally adapted varieties developed and maintained by farmers in traditional agricultural systems.
edits.reason: Landraces versus heirlooms is a genuine botanical distinction, not ordinary knowledge, so it is stated in its own sentence as what a landrace is rather than as a tacked-on contrast.

edits.original: The construct was designed for chloroplast transformation, not nuclear transformation.
edits.replacement: The construct was designed for chloroplast transformation, in which the transgene integrates into the chloroplast genome.
edits.reason: Chloroplast versus nuclear transformation is a real technical distinction, so it is stated positively as what chloroplast transformation does rather than as a trailing "not X" clause.
